name: Excelsior Lobster Salad with Cream Dressing
description: Historical recipe from Common Sense in the Household (1871). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: 1 fine lobster, boiled and when cold picked to pieces, or two small ones
ingredients.originalText: 1 fine lobster, boiled and when cold picked to pieces, or two small ones
ingredients.quantityText: 1 fine lobster, boiled and when cold picked to pieces, or two small ones

ingredients.originalText: ½ cup sweet cream, whipped light to a cupful of froth

ingredients.name: mustard wet up with vinegar
ingredients.originalText: 1 teaspoonful mustard wet up with vinegar

instructions.text: Beat eggs, sugar, salt, mustard, and pepper until light; then, and very gradually, the oil.
When the mixture is quite thick, whip in the lemon.
Beat five minutes before putting in the vinegar.
Just before the salad goes to table add half the whipped cream to this dressing and stir well into the lobster.
Line the salad-bowl with lettuce-leaves; put in the seasoned meat and cover with the rest of the whipped cream.

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat eggs, sugar, salt, mustard, and pepper until light; then, and very gradually, the oil.
2. When the mixture is quite thick, whip in the lemon.
3. Beat five minutes before putting in the vinegar.
4. Just before the salad goes to table add half the whipped cream to this dressing and stir well into the lobster.
5. Line the salad-bowl with lettuce-leaves; put in the seasoned meat and cover with the rest of the whipped cream.

1 teaspoonful mustard wet up with vinegar
